title: "Welcome to my page": your photo as a digital scrapbook intro
summary: Turn one photo of you into a cut-and-paste scrapbook page that says hello to new followers, then bring it to life as a short intro clip.
why: Virlo's trend page, updated November 22, 2026, lists this as a fresh TikTok format spotted about 12 days earlier, with 197 creators posting it in the last 7 days. Creators use AI or a video template to turn a photo into a scrapbook-style intro that opens with "Welcome to my page". We didn't have a scrapbook or page-intro pack yet.
steps: Pick a clear, well-lit photo of yourself, and jot down 3 or 4 small things about you (a hobby, a favourite snack, your city, what you post).
Paste the main prompt into an image tool with your photo, adding your little facts.
If you want motion, put the finished page into an image-to-video tool with the video prompt.
Pin it as your first post and say it's made with AI.

prompts.label: Main prompt: the scrapbook page
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo. Keep their face, hair and features exactly the same. Make a vertical 9:16 digital scrapbook page on cream paper with a soft grain. Cut the person out with a rough white paper edge and stick them in the middle with two strips of washi tape. Across the top, write "welcome to my page" in cut-out paper letters of different colours and sizes. Around the photo, add small hand-drawn doodles, little stars, a paper clip, a pressed flower and three tiny torn-paper labels that say: "[fact 1]", "[fact 2]", "[fact 3]". Warm, cosy colours. Looks hand-made, not glossy. No logos or brand names.

prompts.label: Video prompt: the page builds itself
prompts.text: Use this scrapbook page as the final frame. Make an 8-second vertical clip. Start on blank cream paper. Seconds 0 to 3: the cut-out photo of the person slides in and lands with a little bounce, then two strips of tape press it down. Seconds 3 to 6: the paper letters of "welcome to my page" pop on one at a time, and the doodles draw themselves in. Seconds 6 to 8: the small labels flutter into place and the person in the photo gives a tiny wave. Gentle stop-motion feel, like real paper. Keep the face exactly the same.

prompts.label: Variation: winter edition
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo and keep their face the same. Make a vertical scrapbook page on pale blue paper with paper snowflakes, a knitted mitten sticker, a cup of hot chocolate doodle and a strip of plaid tape. Put the cut-out photo in the centre and write "welcome to my page" in white and red paper letters across the top. Add two little labels: "[what you post]" and "[your city]". Soft, hand-made look. No logos.

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: meet the maker
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo of me [upload] and keep my face the same. Make a vertical scrapbook page on kraft paper. Stick my cut-out photo in the middle with tape, and write "welcome to my page" in cut-out letters at the top. Around me, add small hand-drawn sketches of what I make or sell: [your products], a doodle of my shop or workspace, and three paper tags that say "[what we do]", "[where we are]" and "[one fun fact]". Warm, hand-made feel. No logos or brand names except my own shop name if I add it.

tips: Keep the labels short. Two or three words each reads best on a phone.
Check the spelling of every word on the page. Image tools still slip on letters, so fix or reroll.
Only share facts you're happy for strangers to know. Skip your street, school or workplace.
Say it's made with AI, and only use photos of people who agreed.
